name: On-Demand Models
description: ON-DEMAND multi-model config; weights (9-16 GB) are NEVER baked into image layers. Owns stack.json manifest (single source of truth for bifrost upstreams and opencode role->model mapping). CLOUD_MODE routes all agents to the hosted opencode provider instead of local slots. Profile files .devcontainer/llm-lab-{models,roles}.json are resolved at RUNTIME (postCreateCommand) because the workspace is not mounted during the build stage. Legacy single-model options MODEL/QUANT are deprecated in favor of MODELS.

MODELS.description: JSON array of model specs [{name,provider,hf,quant,url,port,context,parallel,spec_type,spec_draft_n_max}, ...]. Optional url = exact repo/filename.gguf path on huggingface.co; required for real repos, omit for the legacy hf-derived path. Optional spec_type: allowed value "draft-mtp" (requires parallel:1). Optional spec_draft_n_max: integer 1-8 (default llama.cpp 3). Empty = resolve from .devcontainer/llm-lab-models.json at runtime, else default single-model (gemma4-26b-a4b). An explicit value here takes precedence and disables runtime profile resolution.

ROLES.description: JSON object mapping agent role -> {model, slot}. Empty = resolve from .devcontainer/llm-lab-roles.json at runtime, else default 8-role mapping onto the first model. An explicit value here takes precedence and disables runtime profile resolution.

BIFROST_PORT.description: Bifrost gateway port recorded in stack.json (opencode providers route through it)

MODELS_DIR.description: Custom directory for models. Empty = <workspace>/models, resolved at runtime once the workspace is mounted.

CLOUD_MODE.description: Route ALL agents to the hosted opencode provider (cloud) when no explicit MODELS/ROLES are supplied. Set true for GPU-less/cloud boxes. Explicit MODELS (or .devcontainer/llm-lab-models.json) always builds the local slot-pinned stack and wins over CLOUD_MODE.

CLOUD_MODEL.description: Hosted opencode provider model id used by the default cloud role mapping (CLOUD_MODE=true, no ROLES supplied). Override per-role via ROLES or .devcontainer/llm-lab-roles.json.

MODEL.description: (legacy) Hugging Face model repo/filename identifier — superseded by MODELS

QUANT.description: (legacy) Quantization level for the model — superseded by MODELS
